bannerTitle: Template – have it reviewed by a lawyer before going live
bannerBody: This text is a carefully prepared template but does not replace legal advice. Please have it reviewed by a lawyer and adapted to your business before going live.
bindingNotice: Only the German version below is legally binding. This summary is provided for your convenience.

impressum.title: Legal notice
impressum.metaDescription: Provider identification of VeroMenu under Section 5 of the German Digital Services Act (DDG).
impressum.s1: This page lists the name, address and contact details of the company operating VeroMenu.
impressum.s2: It also states the VAT ID, the commercial register entry and the person responsible for the content.
impressum.s3: VeroMenu is offered to businesses only; we do not take part in consumer arbitration proceedings.
impressum.s4: Each restaurant is responsible for its own menu and its own legal notice.

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.metaDescription: How VeroMenu processes personal data: hosting in Germany, no tracking cookies, cookie-free analytics.
datenschutz.s1: We host in Germany and only use strictly necessary cookies – no tracking, no cookie banner.
datenschutz.s2: Menu analytics work without cookies, using a daily-rotating, irreversible hash.
datenschutz.s3: Guest orders are processed on behalf of the restaurant, which is the controller for that data.
datenschutz.s4: For AI features, only menu content is sent to OpenRouter (USA) – never any guest data.
datenschutz.s5: Transfers to third countries rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or Standard Contractual Clauses.
datenschutz.s6: You have the right to access, erasure and objection, and to complain to the supervisory authority.

agb.title: Terms and conditions
agb.metaDescription: Terms and conditions for the use of VeroMenu by restaurants (business customers only).
agb.s1: These terms apply to businesses only, in particular restaurants – not to consumers.
agb.s2: Plans are Free, Starter and Pro; paid plans can be cancelled monthly.
agb.s3: AI results are suggestions that you must review before publishing.
agb.s4: Allergen and additive information remains the sole responsibility of the restaurant.
agb.s5: We commit to 98.5% annual average availability; liability for slight negligence is limited.
agb.s6: German law applies; after the contract ends your data is deleted within 30 days.

avv.title: Data processing agreement (DPA)
avv.metaDescription: Summary of the data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR, including sub-processors.
avv.s1: The restaurant is the controller; VeroMenu processes guest and team data on its behalf.
avv.s2: This mainly covers orders, pseudonymised analytics data and team accounts.
avv.s3: We protect the data with hosting in Germany, encryption and role-based permissions.
avv.s4: Sub-processors are hosting, email delivery and – for menu content only – OpenRouter.
avv.s5: We report data breaches within 48 hours and delete everything within 30 days after the contract ends.
